title: Kissed Caramelized Sicilian Vermicelli Pasta
description: A yeasty, molten, post-workout Italian dish featuring vermicelli pasta, caramelized to perfection, wrapped in a pandan leaf vessel, this low-calorie-friendly meal is a perfect way to refuel after a workout.
instructions: Cook the vermicelli pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the tomato sauce to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shaved grana padano cheese until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked vermicelli pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the tomato sauce.
Spoon the pasta mixture onto the center of each pandan leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the pandan leaves over the pasta to form a square package and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Bake the pandan leaf packages in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the leaves are caramelized and the pasta is heated through.
